cards.card_text: He names the nations that oppressed them before: the Egyptians, Amorites, Ammonites, Philistines, Sidonians, Amalekites and Maonites.
cards.verse_text: The LORD replied, “When the Egyptians, Amorites, Ammonites, Philistines, Sidonians, Amalekites, and Maonites oppressed you and you cried out to Me, did I not save you from their hands?
